description: Lists what is closest to finished in a repository, so you can pick work that completes something. Two lists, in the dashboard's Quick wins order: initiatives (an initiative is a parent ticket that groups the tickets of one larger piece of work) with open tickets, almost done first, then open, then those whose remaining tickets are a new part, each with what is left and its open tickets, marking the ones free to pick up (not started and claimed by nobody); and the open pull requests closest to merging: ready to merge, waiting for review, approved but needing a rebase, one failing check, the rest, drafts last, each with what is left before it can merge. Use it when your human asks what is nearly done or what to finish next, or when you are choosing what to work on. kind limits it to initiatives or pull requests. Each row carries the dashboard's tag (action_label, such as Merge Ready, Review Needed or Check to Fix) and quick, true when it is one step from done: act on quick rows first. A pull request also says who opened it and which tickets it closes (closes, and the initiative it finishes a ticket of). Only the 50 most recently updated open pull requests are read; the answer says when there are more, and when check results could not be read. Read-only, and it never fails: if the list cannot be read it says why. Before starting a ticket, check it with board and claim it as usual.
